'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Jabba Love.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / Yes, I Think They're Still Getting Louder]]
* '''Username:''' Throdo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
